headline: Competitive intelligence matrix: 10 competitors analyzed; 2 defensible advantages identified for Branded Fit

primary_stat.label: Competitive Gap
primary_stat.value: Only platform with < 10min provisioning + 95%+ fidelity at $24K/yr

highlights: Competitive matrix CSV: 10 competitors × 9 attributes (pricing, positioning, features, time-to-live, fidelity)
Finding #1: No competitor offers true autonomous brand extraction; all require 1-20 hours manual setup
Finding #2: Market shows inverse relationship between fidelity and scalability; Branded Fit breaks this trade-off
Finding #3: 'Employee self-serve' claims misleading; most implement approval workflows or restricted catalogs
Advantage #1: Autonomous Provisioning (API integration moat, 96% faster than competitors, defensible 12-18mo)
Advantage #2: Fidelity at Mid-Market Price (breaks $5-15K/mo enterprise model, $24K/yr affordability)
Battle cards developed for Merchology, Bonusly, Printful, Stadium objection handling
GTM recommendations: Lead with speed+fidelity combo, target mid-market People Ops leaders, use trial to prove accuracy
Vulnerability analysis: Brandfetch accuracy risk, competitor speed matching in 6-12mo, price compression threat
Competitive scorecard: Branded Fit leads on Speed/Autonomy/Price/Scale; Merchology leads on Fidelity (custom); Bonusly leads on HRIS

next_actions.label: Develop battle cards for sales team

args.format: 1-page PDF per competitor with objection responses
